QF.id: AIFM CII Investment Process and Governance_46

question.text: 'Deccan Category II AIF' constitutes its Investment Committee. Which composition BEST aligns with SEBI's governance expectation and industry best practice?

answer.text: Internal senior management of the AMC PLUS nominated external members and independent professionals (external members being resident Indian citizens at registration)
Only the founder and two of his close friends

explanation.text: The Logic: The chapter states IC consists of internal senior management of the AMC PLUS nominated external members and independent professionals NOT entrusted with day-to-day AMC management (to prevent conflict). External members must be resident Indian citizens for standard registration processing. The Trap: Founder + friends violates independence. All external creates accountability vacuum. SEBI-officials IC is absurd. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests IC composition. Overlaps with mutual-fund-style IC governance. Manager's Pro-Tip: Pick external IC members with PRIOR deal-screening experience — academic-only or regulatory-only members add little. Ideal mix: 1 retired senior banker, 1 senior PE/VC veteran, 1 sector specialist (rotating).
